newsitem.title: USA: ThermoSpectra sees Q2 charge of $0.03/shr.
newsitem.headline: ThermoSpectra sees Q2 charge of $0.03/shr.

text.p: ThermoSpectra Corp said Tuesday it is taking a one-time, pretax write-down of about $800,000 in the second quarter related to severance costs at its Gould Instrument Systems subsidiary.
ThermoSpectra said it expects that this write-down will impact quarterly earnings by about $0.03 per share.
The subsidiary reduced its workforce late in the second quarter in an effort to lower overall expense levels and improve its profitability.
ThermoSpectra develops, manufactures, and markets precision imaging, inspection, and measurement instrumentation that uses high-speed data acquisition and digital processing technologies.
